name: technical-brief
prompt: Create a polished technical decision brief titled 'Systems Decision Brief' with a subtitle and three top-level sections named 'Context', 'Architecture Options', and 'Recommendation'. Use professional body typography and spacing. Include a 3-column comparison table with a styled header and three data rows, one native equation, one native column chart with three categories and two series, one four-step process SmartArt, a footer with page numbering, Letter pages with 0.75-inch margins, and one positioned shape. Verify the semantic and spatial result before saving.
